title: AI and Holistic Review: Informing Human Reading in College Admissions
reasoning: The paper is a sociotechnical study focused on AI ethics, specifically regarding fairness and bias in college admissions. It includes a significant evaluation of the ethical implications of holistic review, citing historical religious discrimination (anti-Semitism and exclusion of Jewish applicants) as a founding context. The entire study aims to assess how AI can serve as an ethical audit for human-centered processes.
